Meet your driver-guide

Hi, I’m Onila.

I don’t just drive you between hotels. I show you my Sri Lanka — the cooking pot in a village kitchen, the beach nobody posts, the rice-and-curry place locals queue for.

Based in Matara on the south coast, I run Voiture Tours: private, flexible trips around the whole island — airport pickups, hotel-to-hotel transfers, custom day trips and two-week tours. Clean vehicles, professional driving and a schedule that bends to you.

    Good to know

    Questions, answered.

    Still unsure? Ask Onila directly on WhatsApp.

    Ask on WhatsApp
    How much does a private driver in Sri Lanka cost?

    With Voiture Tours you pay one daily price per vehicle — around $65 a day for a car and $85 for a van, including fuel and your driver-guide. Use the trip builder above for an instant estimate.

    Can Onila pick us up from Colombo airport?

    Yes — airport pickups and drop-offs (Bandaranaike International, CMB) are a core service, at any hour. Just send your flight number and Onila will be there.

    Where does the tour start and end?

    Anywhere you like. Most guests start at the airport and finish on the south coast or back at the airport. Onila is based in Matara, so south-coast trips are especially easy.

    Do we have to follow a fixed itinerary?

    No. Every tour is private and flexible — stay longer at a beach you love, skip a temple, add a waterfall. Onila adjusts the plan day by day.

    Where does the driver stay overnight?

    Driver accommodation is arranged by Onila — you only book your own hotels (or ask Onila to book them for you).

    How do we book and pay?

    Send your plan on WhatsApp or email, agree the route and price with Onila, and confirm. Payment details are shared directly with you once your trip is confirmed.
